crossRefs.note: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all…
At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will…
So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out…
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

translations.web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
translations.bsb: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
translations.kjv: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
translations.asv: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.
